Short notes from the account — shorthand and paraphrases below.
- Company: NautilusCX AssistWorks, mid-enterprise contact center platform provider; white-label solutions for telcos & BPO partners.
- Primary pain: unreliable suggestion latency during commercial peaks (campaign spikes, billing cycles) -> agents lose faith in assist suggestions.
- Current stack: Zendesk + internal agent UI; using a lightweight rule-based suggestion layer today.
- POC ask: real-time streaming suggestions with fallbacks, explicit tool-calling into Zendesk and internal CRMs, and robust guardrails for PII/redaction.
- Targets discussed: p95 end-to-end suggestion latency < 250ms, p99 < 600ms under normal load; sustain 1,200 concurrent agent sessions with 5x burst for 5 mins during promotions.
- Throughput: avg 80 reqs/sec per region in pilot; expected 400-800 reqs/sec in production per region.
- Accuracy metric: reduce follow-up edits by agents by 18-25% (measured on labeled prompt set).
- Safety/guardrails: automated hallucination filter for currency/price claims, strict tool-call confirmation step (agent confirms before Zendesk action), supervisor override and audit trail.
- Data residency: customers in EU require logs and transcripts stored in EU region; infosec insists on KMS + customer-managed keys for private deployments.
- Deployment preference: Dedicated capacity for predictable latency; Private (VPC) for EU customers. Will consider on-prem for large BPO customers.
- Quote from Head of Ops: "If the suggestions show up late or wrong, agents ignore them — latency wins over raw accuracy."
- POC success criteria (agreed): 1) p95 latency < 250ms for suggestion commit in staging; 2) tool-call success rate > 98%; 3) no regression in PII leakage checks across sample prompts; 4) human-in-the-loop supervisor flow validated.
- Risks called out: procurement needs to approve a 12-month dedicated commit for pricing to make sense; SOC2 evidence required for private deployment build.
- Next steps: security artifact handoff (drive://security/nautiluscx-security-answers-2026-02.xlsx), logistics for POC ingress to their VPC, sandbox Zendesk API credentials, schedule load test 2026-03-22.
